A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''communications officer''' served aboard the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Black Wave]]'' under [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]] around [[44 ABY]]. After a failed [[Operation Shieldfall|mission]] to kill the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and defeat or capture the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] received a message from Abeloth with the proposition of an alliance and alerted Khai to the matter.

==Appearances==
*''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' {{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Conviction (audiobook)}} {{1st}}
